# Plex File Renamer
# WARNING! The content of this repo has been entirely generated by Google Gemini.

A python script that can be used to organize and rename your local Plex TV Shows 

## Features
- Instantly renames files in a clean and Plex-Friendly format.
- Automatically finds the tv show name.
- Separates different seasons in separate folders

## Requisites
- Python 3.x 

## How to use
- Simply launch app_gui.py or compile it with pyinstaller to create an .exe file
